_provenance.note: final identity; 2026-08-10 revision demoted Live to a proof-only signal, moved actions onto the neutral ramp, unified every radius at 2px, and replaced the mark+text lockup with a drawn wordmark

roles.name: Action
roles.use: primary action fill; carries Backplane ink text (18.7:1)

roles.name: Live
roles.use: PROOF ONLY: status-up, the active route in a topology drawing, the focus ring, the brand mark's turned facet. Never an action, never a bullet, never a decorative arrow.

roles.name: Live Ink
roles.use: docs light-theme text accent (5.94:1 on Paper)

typographyMeta.families: IBM Plex Sans + Geist Mono (OFL, self-hosted)
typographyMeta.earnedMonoRule: mono content must be runnable or live

motion.stance: Motion is reserved for things that are actually happening. The pointer-tracked hero grid, the drifting blur fields, and the conic ring orbiting the primary button were removed in the 2026-08-10 revision: an instrument panel does not shimmer.
sanctioned: topology diagram draws its active route once on load
content of a band rises 10px on first scroll into view (never section heads)

header.constraint: drawn wordmark + Docs-first nav (Static, Signal on hover) + one solid neutral CTA; identical on both origins

footer.constraint: brand column + Product/Deploy/Project + legal strip; every page

topology-diagram.constraint: authored SVG, fold-line vocabulary, aria-label; active path in Live

proof-band.constraint: ruled columns divided by hairlines, not cards; every number links to its receipt or carries its caveat inline

status-readout.constraint: Live/Down semantics; live hydration; timezone on timestamps

wordmark.constraint: drawn SVG, never set in a webfont; monoline geometric on a 19-unit ascender, 3-unit stroke, 12-unit x-height; carries currentColor; appears alone (no pictorial mark beside it) in every header on both origins

capability-index.constraint: verb rail + hairline-separated rows; never a grid of identical cards

identityAssets.mark: square tile + Live folded corner + Live-Deep crease (favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, inline chrome SVGs, og.png)

rules: Banned marketing adjectives; no exclamation points
New copy prefers periods and colons over em-dashes; captured copy preserved
Expand MCP once per page on first use
Every stat carries caveat or receipt-link inline

narrative.northStar: The gateway that proves itself: one governed endpoint, one live-lime thread of proof through near-black instrument panels.
rules: Live is reserved for action and proof
Divergence between origins is a bug
